newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kimmon Manufacturing down on bid-rigging complaint.
newsitem.headline: Kimmon Manufacturing down on bid-rigging complaint.

text.p: Shares in Kimmon Manufacturing Co Ltd slipped on Wednesday, hit by news that Japan's anti-monopoly watchdog had filed a complaint with prosecutors against it, brokers said.
They said the complaint concerned suspected involvement in bid-rigging.
As of 0458 GMT, the shares of the leading maker of water and gas meters were down 38 yen at 425.
"The news of the complaint is depressing the shares," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said. "Overall sentiment is very bad at the moment and the market reacts sharply to such negative factors."
Brokers said Kimmon's comments that its earnings could be affected by the recent action was also acting as a dampener.
The Fair Trade Commission (FTC) on Tuesday filed a complaint with prosecutors against 25 firms including Kimmon.
The FTC said the complaint concerned contracts for water gauges awarded by the Tokyo metropolitan government.
Kimmon said in a statement that it could be barred from bidding for contracts awarded by public institutions for a certain time.
